# Littera — https://www.littera.app.br
# Permite a indexação completa pelos motores de busca (Google, Bing) e agentes de IA (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, etc.)

# Regra padrão para todos os crawlers
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /llms.txt
Allow: /llms-full.txt
Allow: /sitemap.xml
Disallow: /app/
Disallow: /cadastro
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /setup-account
Disallow: /convite
Disallow: /cadastro/finalizar

# Google Search Engine & Imagens
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Disallow: /app/
Disallow: /cadastro
Disallow: /login

User-agent: Googlebot-Image
Allow: /assets/
Allow: /dashboard-student.png
